best_idea: Weight a zone's loot pool so that items the character does not yet own weigh twice the owned ones, draw twice per reward, and write the granted items to a per-character ledger only after both draws.
decision_why: Take the 2:1 ownership weighting and the ledger-after-draws order, keep the weights as zone data and write the ledger on the server; do not copy the stage 3 empty-pool behaviour, which pushes undefined when the pool is exhausted.
acceptance: A server test seeds the roll, gives a fresh character a reward stage with two draws from an eight-item pool, and asserts that the first draw favours unowned items at 2:1, that both drawn items are written to the ledger after the stage, and that an item can repeat within one stage.
